User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the MUBAS Community Hub.

profilePictureUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

reputation.description: User's reputation score within the community.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a question posted in the MUBAS Community Hub.

content.description: The content of the question (actual question text).

userId.description: Reference to the User who posted the question. (Relationship: User 1:N Question)

dateCreated.description: The date and time the question was created.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the question.

viewCount.description: The number of times the question has been viewed.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: Represents an answer to a question in the MUBAS Community Hub.

questionId.description: Reference to the Question this answer belongs to. (Relationship: Question 1:N Answer)

userId.description: Reference to the User who provided the answer. (Relationship: User 1:N Answer)

dateCreated.description: The date and time the answer was created.

isAccepted.description: Indicates whether the answer has been accepted as the correct answer.

upvotes.description: The number of upvotes for the answer.

downvotes.description: The number of downvotes for the answer.

KnowledgeBaseArticle.title: KnowledgeBaseArticle
KnowledgeBaseArticle.description: Represents an article in the knowledge base.

id.description: Unique identifier for the knowledge base article.

authorId.description: Reference to the User who authored the article. (Relationship: User 1:N KnowledgeBaseArticle)

dateCreated.description: The date and time the article was created.

lastUpdated.description: The date and time the article was last updated.

category.description: The category of the knowledge base article.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the knowledge base article.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user.

userId.description: Reference to the User the notification is for. (Relationship: User 1:N Notification)

dateCreated.description: The date and time the notification was created.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the notification has been read.

type.description: The type of notification (e.g., new answer, mention).

relatedItemId.description: Reference to the related item (e.g., question id, answer id).

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to address the 'auth/operation-not-allowed' error, ensure security, and support the features of the MUBAS Community Hub. The core strategy revolves around authorization independence through denormalization and structural segregation for simplified security rules and QAPs.

**Authorization Independence:**
*   User roles and memberships are crucial for authorization. To avoid `get()` calls in security rules, user roles (student, admin) are stored directly within the `users` document.

**Structural Segregation:**
*   User-generated content (questions and answers) is stored under the respective user's path (`/users/{userId}/questions/{questionId}`). This simplifies ownership-based security rules.
*   Knowledge base articles, managed by admins, are stored in a separate collection (`/knowledge_base_articles`). This segregation allows distinct security rules for admin-managed content versus user-generated content.

**Access Modeling:**
*   Path-based ownership is used for questions and answers to simplify security rules based on the user ID. Notifications also follow the same pattern.

**QAPs Support:**
*   Secure `list` operations are enabled by the homogeneous security posture of each collection. For example, listing questions under a user's path is secure because all documents in that subcollection are owned by that user.

This structure enables simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules, minimizing complexity and ensuring data integrity.
